hook_text: One market day, every Term 3 skill. From the cake stall to the tiled courtyard in sixty seconds.
clip_script: Market day in Graaff-Reinet. Cake stall: 8 slices, 3 sold, five eighths left. Two eighths plus three eighths? Five eighths, keep the bottom. Three quarters of 24 cupcakes: 18. Survey table: cakes 15, sweets 10, games 9, crafts 6, total 40. Bar graph from 0. Cakes beat crafts by 9. Coin toss: heads or tails, about half, no memory. Sweet stall: 6 bags of 250 grams, 1 500 grams, one and a half kilograms. Courtyard: square tiles, no gaps, no overlaps. The stop sign at the gate: octagon, 8 lines of symmetry. Draw it, label it, total it, check it.
visual_style: Whiteboard market map with each stall lighting up as its skill appears; small fraction bars, a bar graph, a scale and tiles beside each stall.
mood: Energetic recap, a tour with a purpose.
pacing: Five quick stalls, one skill each, then the four checking habits.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a one-page map of Term 3 before the test.
